description: This file defines the Config_File class for reading and parsing configuration files in PHP, including methods for loading files, retrieving configuration data, and handling options related to config parsing.

classes.name: Config_File
classes.description: A class for reading, parsing, and managing configuration files with options for handling hidden sections, overwriting variables, and fixing newlines.

methods.name: Config_File
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the Config_File object, optionally setting the config path.

methods.name: set_path
methods.description: Sets the directory path where configuration files are located.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves configuration data based on filename, section, and variable name.

methods.name: get_key
methods.description: Retrieves configuration data based on a combined key in the format 'file/section/var'.

methods.name: get_file_names
methods.description: Returns a list of all loaded configuration file names.

methods.name: get_section_names
methods.description: Returns all section names from a specified configuration file.

methods.name: get_var_names
methods.description: Returns variable names from a file or section.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears loaded configuration data for a specific file or all files.

methods.name: load_file
methods.description: Loads and parses a configuration file from disk.

methods.name: set_file_contents
methods.description: Sets configuration data directly from a string content.

methods.name: parse_contents
methods.description: Parses configuration data from a string, handling sections, variables, and multiline values.

methods.name: _set_config_var
methods.description: Internal method to set a configuration variable, handling boolean conversion and overwriting.

methods.name: _trigger_error_msg
methods.description: Internal method to trigger a PHP warning/error with a message.
